experience.visibleOutcome: Named environments show room-specific scenery; the Creator snaps a clue to a wall and returns to the same Library
experience.integrationOwner: Parallax rooms and surface placement integration
experience.accessibility: Keyboard entry and visible focus reach assistance, docking and return; readable themes and reduced motion retain meaning. Floating title and all edge/corner handles support arrow keys, with Shift for larger steps.
experience.fallback: Without a configured credential or AI allowance, ordinary authoring and guided placement controls remain available.
experience.navigation: Creator Library opens Spatial Studio; assistance overlays the scene; closing and returning restores the ordinary Creator Library.
experience.designTarget: Use an entirely light or dark blue authoring workspace with separated title/status, clear populated dock sections, and an assistant overlay that never shrinks the canvas. Floating assistance can move and resize inside the visible Studio; the composer remains at the bottom and saved window geometry never changes authored content. The Surfaces control outlines complete current room planes and offers a compact accessible picker. Selecting a wall or furniture aligns the object to its normal, with clear manual/automatic placement language and ordinary Undo. Each named synthetic environment has its own meaningful layout and furnishings, an empty room contains only its shell, and changing environments frames the complete scene. The strengthened construction candidate must show complete thick architecture with true window/door apertures, grounded or explicitly supported/mounted furnishings, legitimate stacks, and continuous trail terrain/path geometry. Independent exact-feature findings remain separate from confidence and visual quality. Compare all ten reference rooms at normal working sizes and retain actual renderer cost and instance-bound measurements.
